id: AT-STATE-ROOT-06 (state-root: migrate's copy never leaves a cut-off file; a new root inside the old one is not copied into itself)
note: STATE-ROOT (0.1.2): util::copy_new, migrate's copy, writes under a temp name beside the file and links it into place: a write that fails part way leaves nothing under the file's name and no temp name, a rerun copies it, the mtime given is kept, and an existing file is never replaced. migrate skips the new root when it lies inside the old one ($XDG_STATE_HOME under ~/.claude/trash-staging), so nothing is copied into itself.

an existing file is left as it is
